groups.title: Portraits
groups.theme: People, painted fast: hats, hoods, glasses, beards and cigarettes, most made in the four days from Nov 5 to Nov 8, 2022.

groups.title: Patterned Masks and Black Figures
groups.theme: Packed, patterned masks on pink, then flat black cartoon figures in mazes and frames, then heads drawn in a few loose lines on bright grounds.

groups.title: Scribbled Heads and Two Landscapes
groups.theme: Dark scribbled heads from the winter, a last run of masks and figures, and the two painted landscapes that end the series.
